scope: Happy DOM and virtual JS timers; verifies art wiring and scheduled callbacks, not actual CSS rendering, frame rate, real browser or phone behavior.

checks.name: Browser-compatible parser loads all 37 real SVGs and 26 placeholders
Hit effect and damage text originate at scaled manifest hitPoint
Broken monster returns to daze after hit and persistent SVG nodes are reused
Clock uses namespaced text slot and no external countdown badge
Countdown tick restores warn at one and clears warn at larger values
Hand art animates while row and growth art use static URLs and tools pause after play
Mirror remains unresolved for 199 ms then reveals resolved art at 200 ms
All eleven effects center and scale correctly, use manifest durations and leave no nodes
Heart loss plays from attack impact and replaces only the lost heart at completion
Stone crossing a form boundary fills and resets the same ring over 600 ms
Healing heart gains and fx_heal survives for its complete 700 ms duration
